projection: south polar stereographic, spherical, true scale at -90 deg
orientation: row-major; row 0 is +Y (0 deg E); columns increase +X (90 deg E); +Y points north at longitude 0
referenceFrame: Mean Earth / Polar Axis of DE421
resampling: Area mean of 7-8 original pixels per axis, quantized to uint16; nominal output pixel 593.75m
limitations: Render only the valid80-90S polar disc; square corners lie outside the stated latitude coverage.
Terrain is sampled topography, not an operational landing hazard map.
